titulo: Pasta de downloads mostra o destino das iscas em PDF
descricao: Um celular central exibe uma pasta de downloads cheia de PDFs e o aviso de que nunca foram abertos. O título apresenta o problema e a chamada inferior propõe uma nova isca digital.
por_que_funciona: A lista longa de arquivos torna visível o acúmulo de PDFs.
O aviso “Last opened: Never” concentra a crítica ao baixo uso dos materiais.
O celular isolado sobre fundo escuro mantém a atenção na pasta de arquivos.
A chamada inferior oferece uma continuidade direta para o problema mostrado.
quando_usar: Para atrair produtores e profissionais de marketing que distribuem materiais gratuitos e querem aumentar o uso após o download.
estrutura_texto:
[Local onde o material fica].
Seu [conteúdo] sem leitura.
[Interface com lista de materiais acumulados]
Crie esta nova [isca] →
[Benefício de uso esperado]
legenda: Você dedica [tempo] a criar [material gratuito], divulga e recebe downloads. Mas quanto desse conteúdo chega a ser usado? Conheça [alternativa] e veja como criar uma experiência voltada a [ação útil para o público]. [CTA].

fonte.texto_original:
You spent a weekend on it, wrote the outline, designed the cover in Canva, agonized over the color palette, rewrote the intro three times, launched it, promoted it. 

You watched the downloads come in and felt — for a second — like you'd built something that mattered.

Here's where it went.

Their downloads folder. Stacked between 11 other PDFs they also never opened. "Last opened: Never." Your beautiful freebie is sitting next to The Ultimate Email List Guide from August 2020 and The Perfect Webinar Script from March 2022. None of them got read.

This is a format problem. People don't read PDFs anymore. They download them, feel good about it for 10 seconds, and forget.

The new lead magnet is an experience they actually finish. We call it a MATE.

In this training, we'll show you exactly what it is and how to build one.I built my first business teaching people to make PDF lead magnets.

The Canva kits, ebook templates, Instagram posts selling "ultimate guides." Thousands of people built their first freebies with my stuff in 2019, 2020, 2021. It worked. It built real businesses.

That was the last big thing.

The bar has moved since then. PDFs that pulled 30% opt-ins in 2022 pull 4% now. Checklists get deleted. Quizzes feel gimmicky. Custom GPTs dead-end halfway through. 

A new format is taking over — and the first movers reaping the benefits.

I'm telling you this because I spotted the last wave. And I'm telling you I've spotted the next one.

We call it a MATE. Not a PDF. Not a checklist. Not a Custom GPT. Something entirely new.

In this $7 training, we'll show you exactly what it is and how to build one and give you the one we use to build our business.
